endScreen.title: Heart Full

gratitude.name: Gratitude
gratitude.description: Questions to help you recognize and appreciate the positives.

questions.question: What small moment made today slightly easier to inhabit?
Who made room for you recently, and what did they make possible?
Which difficulty taught you something without needing to become a blessing?
What ordinary object quietly supports your life every day?
Which memory can still change the temperature of a bad day?
What did your body carry you through today, even imperfectly?
Which ability do you rely on so often that you forget it is a strength?
What did you notice outside that asked nothing from you?
What recent lesson cost enough that you do not want to waste it?
What are you looking forward to that does not need to be impressive?
